verses.en: Hear my cry, O God; attend unto my prayer.
verses.pt: Ouve, ó Deus, o meu clamor; atende à minha oração.
verses.en_web: Hear my cry, God. Listen to my prayer.
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker. On a corded instrument. Of David.> Let my cry come to you, O God; let your ears be open to my prayer.

verses.en: From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
verses.pt: Desde a extremidade da terra clamo a ti, estando abatido o meu coração; leva-me para a rocha que é mais alta do que eu.
verses.en_web: From the end of the earth, I will call to you, when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
verses.en_bbe: From the end of the earth will I send up my cry to you, when my heart is overcome: take me to the rock which is over-high for me.

verses.en: For thou hast been a shelter for me, and a strong tower from the enemy.
verses.pt: Pois tu és o meu refúgio, uma torre forte contra o inimigo.
verses.en_web: For you have been a refuge for me, a strong tower from the enemy.
verses.en_bbe: For you have been my secret place, and my high tower from those who made war on me.

verses.en: I will abide in thy tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert of thy wings. Selah.
verses.pt: Deixa-me habitar no teu tabernáculo para sempre; dá que me abrigue no esconderijo das tuas asas.
verses.en_web: I will dwell in your tent forever. I will take refuge in the shelter of your wings. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: I will make your tent my resting-place for ever: I will keep myself under the cover of your wings. (Selah.)

verses.en: For thou, O God, hast heard my vows: thou hast given me the heritage of those that fear thy name.
verses.pt: Pois tu, ó Deus, ouviste os meus votos; deste-me a herança dos que temem o teu nome.
verses.en_web: For you, God, have heard my vows. You have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.
verses.en_bbe: For you, O God, have made answer to my prayers; you have given me the heritage of those who give honour to your name.

verses.en: Thou wilt prolong the king’s life: and his years as many generations.
verses.pt: Prolongarás os dias do rei; e os seus anos serão como muitas gerações.
verses.en_web: You will prolong the king’s life; his years shall be for generations.
verses.en_bbe: You will give the king long life; and make his years go on through the generations.

verses.en: He shall abide before God for ever: O prepare mercy and truth, which may preserve him.
verses.pt: Ele permanecerá no trono diante de Deus para sempre; faze que a benignidade e a fidelidade o preservem.
verses.en_web: He shall be enthroned in God’s presence forever. Appoint your loving kindness and truth, that they may preserve him.
verses.en_bbe: May the seat of his authority be before God for ever; may mercy and righteousness keep him safe.

verses.en: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, that I may daily perform my vows.
verses.pt: Assim cantarei louvores ao teu nome perpetuamente, para pagar os meus votos de dia em dia.
verses.en_web: So I will sing praise to your name forever, that I may fulfill my vows daily.
verses.en_bbe: So will I make songs in praise of your name for ever, giving to God that which is right day by day.
